mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.athlete_id, m.measure_date, m.height, m.weight, m.sit_height, m.body_fat_rate, m.waist, m.data_source, m.source_task_id, m.source_session_key, m.create_by, m.create_time, a.name AS athlete_name, d.dept_name AS athlete_team FROM apms_body_measure m LEFT JOIN apms_athlete a ON m.athlete_id = a.athlete_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: WHERE athlete_id = #{athleteId} ORDER BY measure_date DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_body_measure ( athlete_id, measure_date, height, weight, sit_height, body_fat_rate, waist, data_source, source_task_id, source_session_key, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{athleteId}, #{measureDate}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{sitHeight}, #{bodyFatRate}, #{waist}, #{dataSource}, #{sourceTaskId}, #{sourceSessionKey}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
